Dialogs.Dialog: If you lose rock-paper-scissors... you do what I say... got it？
Yes... that's 50 wins in a row...
If it bugs you so much, try and catch me... Over here...
Geez... you're late... It's past our meeting time...
It's okay... you don't have to apologize so much...
If you kiss me... maybe I'll forgive you...
And the bell rings to start the match...
Hey... dar-ling... wake up... you'll be late...
Come home... early today, okay... 'Cause I get lonely...
Welcome home... Do you want dinner？ A bath？ Or... potato chips▼
Rinko has been... reborn as Kitty Rinko, meow...
Rinko is gonna... curl up under the kotatsu... meow.
Where I feel safest... is on my boyfriend's lap... meow... purr...
I wonder what he has planned for our date tomorrow...
I wonder if it'll be sunny tomorrow, or what.
Can't tomorrow hurry up and get here already...
...Sigh. How many times have I checked the clock now？ How impatient can I be.
I wonder what I should say to him first tomorrow.
Maybe I'll show up early tomorrow and surprise him. Hehe.
Maybe I'll try acting extra affectionate tomorrow... Hehe.
Is it normal for your heart to race like this the day before a date？ I wonder if he feels the same way.
Our date tomorrow... Hehe, I can't stop grinning.
I can't wait to see him... Not that I'd ever tell him I feel this way.
Yesterday's date... Hehe, that was fun.
I think I'm still caught up in the afterglow of our date...
I wonder where he'll take me next...
I wonder when our next date is？ I hope he sets it up soon.
We just had a date yesterday, and I already want to see him again... Do I have it bad or what？
Hehe... "My boyfriend's house," huh. That has a special ring to it.
I guess my heart only raced that much because it was a date with him.
Time flies when you're having fun... huh. I wish time had just stopped during our date.
Maybe I'll text him... Though I don't want to interrupt his studying.
Sigh, I have to study... Or maybe I'll just skip it.
Just one text couldn't hurt, right... Ugh, come on, focus!
I get so much more done when the two of us study together...
Maybe I'll ask him to study with me again. Makes my life easier, anyway.
Oh, this problem... I forgot to get his help on it. ...Still, I guess it's an excuse to study together again.
Sigh. Too excited to sleep—I'm acting like a little kid...
The time we're meeting is... yep, all good.
I wish tomorrow would hurry up and... Ugh, seriously, I'm way too excited for this.
I think I want to do it some more...
Kissing, huh... Hehe. I think I kind of like it.
...My heart's still racing. Am I losing my mind or something？
So kissing really makes your heart... pound like this, huh.
That was intense... I swear I can still feel it.
We kissed... again. ...I wonder if I'm getting any better at it...
Lonely just from being apart for a little while... Does that mean I like him that much？
Thinking about my boyfriend nonstop every day... Do I have it bad or what？
Man... Is he gonna show up in my dreams again tonight, too？
"I love you"... There's no way I could say that to his face.
At this rate, I don't think I'll be able to hold back how much I like him...
I don't know why, I just... really like him.
I wish he were here with me... Yeah, right.
If I messaged him out of the blue... would that bother him？
I want to hear... his voice.
Being in love... might actually be kind of fun.
I'd like to spend more time together, though... Well, that'd probably bring its own problems. Maybe things are best the way they are now.
I wonder if he's feeling the same way right now...
I feel like we've been out of sync a lot lately.
I wish he'd treat me more like his girlfriend, though...
Could this be what they call a rut？
He seems a little distant lately. Is it just my imagination...？
I'd really rather feel happier about things than this...
Sigh... I don't even know anymore...
Why doesn't he get how I feel...？
Ugh, seriously, this is the worst!
He's not planning on just leaving me like this, is he？
Time to get up...？ Eh, whatever.
It's just being late... Yeah, just a little late.
Why am I so... sleepy... I'm being tricked.
Hey, this might actually be pretty good.
Never skip prep and review. ...Well, as much as I can manage, anyway.
...Ugh, I don't get this at all.
This might make my boyfriend fall for me all over again.
I wonder if he'll notice my new scent.
Maybe I'll ask him to walk home with me for a change.
Maybe we should've walked home together today...
Walking home alone really feels like something's missing.
Lunch... Well, I guess eating alone is fine today.
Maybe I'll ask him to eat lunch with me.
I wonder if he already ate... Maybe we should've eaten together.
*Sigh* Don't go skipping out on me... I get lonely, you know.
He's not here today... I wonder what happened.
I wonder if he's not coming today. Well, whatever... Not like I care.
Still awake？ I'm still good to stay up, so wanna talk？
Won't tomorrow be rough if you don't sleep soon？ Even I'm getting sleepy...
Morning. ...Don't tell me you pulled an all-nighter？ Sleep is important, you know.
Morning. Did you eat a proper breakfast？ I know it's a hassle sometimes, but... if I made it for you, you'd feel like eating, right？
Hehe. Your half-asleep face is fun to watch, too. Me, I'm already wide awake.
Morning. Waking up early feels great. Plus, it gives us time to take it easy and talk like this.
Mmm, noon already... It's fine, I'll get serious this afternoon. Totally fine.
Eating made me sleepy. Wanna take a nap together？ Side by side... or something.
Did you eat a proper meal？ I'm sure you're fine, just don't make me worry too much.
Mmm, guess I can finally catch my breath. I worked hard.
Ah, were you spacing out just now？ I've got my eyes on you, so snap out of it.
Hey. What were you thinking about just now？ As for me... Come on, look at my face and take a guess.
Ah, I have to do my homework... Um... do I really have to？
I think I'll take a bath and go to bed soon. ...Don't stay up too late either, okay？
Wonder if I'll see you in my dreams... Just kidding. Hehe.
...Are you still up？ ...I'm so sleepy... Can't we save the rest for tomorrow？
I was just about to go to sleep, but... oh well. Just for a little bit, okay？
Going to sleep already...？ I can stay up a little longer... What do you wanna do？
What'd you come here for？ ...Just kidding. Honestly, I was really lonely, wondering every single day why you wouldn't come see me.
You've been coming to see me every day lately. Thanks. Seeing my boyfriend's face really is the best.
If I start slacking on fashion... that'd make me a bad girlfriend, right？
This probably doesn't work... Or maybe it does.
This combination... yeah, it might work.
I wonder if he'll tell me I look cute.
I wonder if he'll like this color？
I wonder if he'll notice even a small change.
Maybe I should be a little more adventurous with how I dress...？
I wonder what kind of look he likes... Ugh, this is hard.
I think I'm onto something with this one.
Hmm, maybe the last one was cuter.
Let's see... What should I write？
Hehe... Maybe he's waiting for an email from me, too.
Hehe, that moment a message comes in is so nice.
Sent! Wonder if he'll read it right away.
Oh, right, I have to get ready...
Oh, right. While I have a minute...
Think I'm getting a little hungry...
...Come to think of it, things have felt a little tight around my waist lately.
Did I lose a little weight？
Come to think of it, I have been eating a lot on our dates.
Hmm. Well, I don't really eat out much.
Hehe, I think this turned out pretty well, if I do say so myself.
Turned out great. I bet he'll be surprised when I have him try it.
Having someone to cook for really helps you improve, huh.
Yep, that's the taste right there.
Hmm... Something seems a little off.
Huh？ Wasn't it supposed to go like this？
As long as I follow the recipe, it should be fine... I think.
This looks a little iffy... Wonder if I can still save it.
I wonder if he'll like the lunch I made.
If I'm going to make it for him, I want to surprise him.
Making a lunch look colorful matters too, right...
I wonder if he'll eat it all.
Maybe I'll try practicing that new recipe right away.
He wasn't too impressed last time... Time to redeem myself!
Hehe. Getting praised really does motivate you, huh.
This one's nice... Hmm, what should I do.
Huh... That's not bad at all.
...Is this one a little too cute for me？
It'd be nice if I could pull off an outfit like this...
Oh, I could probably take some pointers from this outfit.
This looks good. I wonder if he'd like it.
Oh, I've been looking for this recipe.
What should I make next time？
I wonder if there's anything in here I can actually make...
Life would be easy if just staring at recipes made me a better cook.
Mm, I'll stop after just a little more.
Ugh... I might've eaten too much.
I could get hooked on these.
Mmm... Such a nice morning it's making me sleepy...
Hm？ I feel like someone's watching me...
Feels like someone's peeking at me... No way, right.
Light kick! ...Wait, I could've sworn I sensed something weird.
Hey, want to talk for a bit？
You're free to talk right now, right？
Hey. I kind of want to talk for a minute.
Come on, you at least have time to talk, don't you？
Hey, what're you doing right now？
So, did anything good happen today？
Hehe. Casual little chats like this are important, right？
Hey, there's somewhere I want you to come with me sometime.
Is anything bothering you？ I can at least listen.
All right, tell me something interesting.
Hey, have there been any good shows on lately？
You should recommend a book to me for a change.
Hm... Were you looking at something？
I guess second-year classes really are harder than first-year ones, huh. Ugh.
I feel like potato chips taste a little different depending on the season, even if it's the same flavor. Maybe it's just me.
You've got your hands full with clubs and work and all that. Just being on the library committee is plenty for me.
What movies are playing right now, again？
There's this band I've been really into lately. Wanna give them a listen sometime？
Horoscopes in magazines really stick in your head sometimes, don't they？
Do you know a lot about cell phones？ Not that I'm looking to get a new one, I just don't know much about them.
I wonder if we're okay on time.
Huh, did you not hear me？ Oh well.
Are you busy right now？ Catch you later, then.
Hey... Guess it can wait till later.
Well, let me know when you feel like talking.
Done already？ See you later, then.
I wouldn't mind talking longer... Then again, we can talk anytime.
Guess we can't just stand here talking forever.
Things have been going great for you lately, haven't they？
Bingo! Of course I can tell just by looking at you.
Huh, really？ Sure looks like it to me, though.
Hey, have things been going well lately？
I knew it. I thought so.
Hmm, maybe you just haven't noticed.
Hey, how have you been doing lately？
Oh, really. Well, we all have days like that.
Hey, have you been feeling down lately？ I kind of get that feeling.
I see... Guess it's up to me to cheer you up, then.
Well, okay then... Just don't push yourself too hard.
Hey, you probably shouldn't overdo it today. I just have a feeling.
I jumped out of bed thinking I was late... and then realized we're off today.
You really have to savor breakfast on a day off. It's a nice, relaxing moment.
I really should help out with chores on my days off. My mom works, too, after all.
There's nothing more disappointing than waking up early by accident on a day off.
Going back to sleep once, twice, three times... Wonder how far I can push my record.
It's so easy to get sucked into morning TV. And it's always right when you have to leave that something interesting comes on.
I think I had a dream about you today... maybe. I don't really remember much of it, though.
So I forgot to do my homework. Think I can talk my way out of it somehow？
I had a whole ordeal this morning trying to find my house key. Turned out it was in my uniform pocket the whole time.
My fried egg at breakfast had a double yolk. Feels like a little bonus.
Nothing beats lounging around until noon on a day off. I wish every day could be like this.
I tagged along with my mom to go shopping and found some clothes you might like. Wonder if I should get them.
A neighbor asked me to walk their dog. It's not bad, I guess... but I still prefer cats.
My mom made some sweets today. Maybe I'll ask her to teach me how...
The school store was even rowdier than usual. Did something new come out or something？
Apparently a stray dog wandered into the school. ...Didn't get us out of class, though.
I think I had a little bit of... girl talk with my friends at lunch.
The school flowerbeds aren't half bad, you know. Whenever something changes, it kind of catches my eye.
I got scolded by the teacher for passing notes with a friend during class. Just another page in the book of youth, I guess.
There's this guy and girl in my class who are always arguing. What if they actually like each other...？ Wonder if that's it.
Maybe I should jog around the neighborhood or something to get more exercise. That's a pretty high bar for me, though.
Sounds like there's construction going on nearby. I turned my music way up to compete with it and got yelled at. So unfair.
I snapped at my little brother over something stupid. That wasn't very mature of me. I need to apologize properly.
I randomly bumped into some kids from my old middle school while I was out. We only talked for a bit, though.
My brother's friends swarmed me earlier and it was a lot to handle. Can't really brush them off when they're beaming up at me like that, though.
Looks like there was a traffic accident in the neighborhood. You be careful out there too, okay？ Promise me.
Setting up crepe and takoyaki stands right near the school... That's playing dirty. There's no resisting that.
Got stuck listening to the teacher lecture me. Even though I didn't do anything wrong. *sigh*
A friend got her heart broken and vented to me, but I didn't really know what to say. That stuff's hard.
I got praised for my reading in Japanese class today. The teacher said it was full of emotion... even though I was half-asleep.
Maybe I'll help make dinner tonight. ...I'd be a lot more motivated if you were eating it too, though.
Since it's a day off, I took a longer bath than usual. Soaking while reading a book is actually pretty nice. I recommend it.
I binged a drama I had recorded and now my eyes are tired... It was good, though, so it was worth it.
I made curry for dinner, but it didn't turn out as good as I expected. Wonder where I messed up.
We had a blackout here earlier. Was everything okay on your end？
That new show that started today was actually pretty good. Maybe try tuning in next week？
I stayed in the bath a bit too long and got a little dizzy. Ahh, my head's all fuzzy, though. Feels kind of nice.
I read a book to my little brother today. Wonder if he'll turn into a bookworm too.
There was a scary story special on TV, and... ...Never mind, it's nothing.
I feel like I'm gonna sleep really well tonight. Just a hunch.
I got carried away talking on the phone with a friend, and now it's this late. ...I should probably go to bed.
Made the most of my day off again today. Can't they flip the ratio of weekdays to weekends？
I wonder if having a slumber party with girlfriends is fun. Though I guess guys have their own version of that too.
My futon is super fluffy today. Hehe, I think I'll sleep like a log.
It's this late already... I feel like there's a time thief around.
The air feels really clear tonight for some reason. I wonder what's different.
...I had a bad dream and woke up. Makes me feel like I lost to something.
Nothing beats late-night TV when you can't sleep. I actually kind of like just flipping through the channels.
I was reading and playing games to avoid my homework, and now it's this late...
A pair of cats are meowing outside at this hour. Maybe they're on a late-night date.
Hey, are you the type who likes exercising？
Hey, are you any good at drawing？
Hey, how interested are you in fashion and stuff？
Hey, are you pretty thorough when it comes to cleaning？
Hey, are you actually good at cooking, by any chance？
Hey, do you keep up with your laundry？
Hey, do you like going out for fun？
Hey, are you the type who likes relaxing indoors？
Hey, do you like taking walks in the park？
Hey, don't you think looking around old buildings is pretty fun？
Hey, do you like being active？
Hey, do you like going shopping？
Hey, when you take pictures, do you prefer taking them of girls？
Hey, don't you kind of like the atmosphere in churches？
Hey, do you ever go to live shows？
Hey, do you ever sing when you're in a good mood？
Hey, are you the type who plays a lot of games？
Hey, do you usually listen to music？
Hey, do you watch much anime？
Hey, do you like amusement park dates？
Hey, are you a pretty good swimmer？
Hey, are you the type who likes stargazing？
Hey, being surrounded by plants is relaxing, isn't it？
Hey, when there's an event going on, do you usually go check it out？
Hey, do you actually like shopping？
Hey, do you like going to the beach？
Hey, so are you into seeing girls in swimsuits and stuff？
Hey, would you ever want to try mountain climbing？
Hey, do you like animals and stuff？
Hey, do you like being surrounded by nature？
Hey, don't you end up staying in the bath for a long time？
Hey, what do you usually do before going to bed？
What do you do when you can't sleep？
If you had a pet, would you want a cat or a dog？
Have you been keeping up with your studies before bed lately？
Do you have any good book recommendations for before bed？
What kind of dates do you like？
If we went on a trip together, where would you want to go？
Don't you think it's nice when couples still hold hands even when they're old？
What do you think about romance that's like a TV drama？
You get too excited to sleep the night before a date, don't you？
You remember all of our anniversaries, obviously, right？
Do you like hugging or being hugged more？
Name five things you like about your girlfriend right now. Hehe.
Hey... Do you think... I've gotten better at kissing？
Hey, do you really... understand girls？ Is there anything you don't get？
Just as I expected. I knew it.
I'm not so sure about that.
Mm, I just felt like asking.
There's no deep meaning behind it or anything.
Hehe, I'll make a note of that.
So that's one way to answer, huh.
I just want to know everything about my boyfriend, no matter how small.
Come to think of it, did I ask you this before？
Sorry for asking so many times. I just can't help being curious.
Did I ask the same thing before？ Well, as your girlfriend, I want to stay up to date.
Hey. Is bigger really better after all？
But I wonder what counts as big.
...I don't know what to say to that.
I wonder if I've gained weight lately. Is it noticeable？
Ugh, so you did notice... Maybe I should go on a bit of a diet.
Oh, really? Maybe I'm just overthinking it.
I feel like I've been eating too much lately... I still look fine though, right？
...Right. Well, if you can't tell just by looking, I'm safe.
Yeah... Not that I'm super worried about it or anything.
I knew it... Honestly, yeah. *Sigh*... So I've gained enough that it shows, huh.
Really？ I shouldn't have put on that much, though.
Hey, will you tell me what kind of food you like？
Are you a fan of Japanese food？
Do you like dishes that, you know... don't really fit into a genre？
Hehe, I see. Then you might have something to look forward to.
Oof... I see. Guess I need to practice...
Come on... You could always start liking it now, you know.
Hmm. Well, a girlfriend should know what her boyfriend likes.
Got it. Don't mind me, just doing a little research.
I see. Maybe I'll study up on it.
I got a new recipe the other day, so I was thinking of trying it out.
I found another good recipe. If you don't mind being my guinea pig... I'm kidding, obviously.
I've been really into making Western food lately. I'm doing my homework on it and everything.
I've been really into making Chinese food lately. Using stuff I've eaten myself as a reference.
I've been really into making Japanese food lately. My mom's been teaching me some things, too.
It's pretty cool when you can cook without being tied to any one style, you know.
I've been having fun making sweets lately... Surprising？
Hey, what are we doing for our next date？ Have you decided？
Hehe, nice. Guess I'll just look forward to it, then.
Then maybe we should figure it out together. Where should we go...
How about somewhere quiet and relaxing.
Somewhere lively could be nice, too.
Maybe I'd like to go somewhere we haven't been yet.
I feel like we've been to most of the date spots already.
Where did you have the most fun going before？ Going back there wouldn't be a bad idea.
Somewhere near a good place to eat might be nice.
For our next date, maybe somewhere indoors would be good.
For our next date, want to go somewhere outdoors？
Then how about this: for our next date, we go see a show or an exhibit or something.
Hey, how about going shopping on our next date？
Hey, want to do something active on our next date？
Hey, want to go somewhere we can just take it easy on our next date？
Hey, for our next date, maybe somewhere we can really have fun.
Hehe. That's right, you should always listen to your girlfriend.
Guess it's settled, then. I'll look forward to it.
Oh, really？ Well, think it over.
Hmm. Guess that means you already have something in mind.
I'll look forward to the day of.
Planning things out ahead of time really is half the fun of a date.
Going somewhere after school isn't a bad idea every once in a while.
Don't forget to check out good places to eat nearby, too.
Make sure you plan it out properly so it's a fun date, okay.
I better start picking out what I'm going to wear.
Wonder what we should do... after the date.
We'll have to be careful not to stay out too late again.
Hey, do you like it when... your girlfriend kisses you first？
I see... It's really not so bad, you know.
I see... It makes me a little nervous, though.
Oh, I see. So you'd rather be the one to initiate it.
Oh, I see. Well, that might be easier on me, honestly.
So, do guys really like... um, kissing a girl kind of forcefully？
So you really do？ Hmm, well, it's not like I mind it that much, actually.
Does that mean... you're waiting for me to make the first move？ I'll try my best, I guess.
Oh, I see... Still, every once in a while...
Hey. Where do you like, um... touching me the most？
I see. It makes me feel relaxed, too.
Hehe. It's a little embarrassing, though.
Oh, I see. Like linking arms and stuff... right.
Yeah, we can really feel each other close that way.
Wait, you mean... kissing？ That's way too direct.
Hey, do you like feeding each other？
Yeah, it's a little awkward with people watching... but I don't dislike it.
To tell the truth, I kind of always wanted to try this... or something.
Well, sharing a meal is apparently an important factor for a couple.
Really？ I don't mind it, personally.
Hmm. Having you feed me once in a while isn't so bad, though.
Wait... does that mean you're embarrassed？
Hey. Have you been getting enough sleep lately？
Hey. Have you been getting enough exercise？
Hey. Have you been eating three proper meals a day？
Hey. You haven't been eating too many snacks, have you？
Hey. Are you staying warm enough when you sleep？
Hey. Do you make sure to turn off the AC before going to sleep？
Give me a straight answer. Come on.
As your girlfriend, I want to keep track of this stuff.
If you don't want to say, fine, just know that I'm worried about you.
Huh, that's perfect. You're really on top of things.
You're taking good care of yourself. Not bad.
So, more or less... huh. That worries me a little. Be careful, okay？
Seriously？ If you don't fix that, you're gonna make yourself sick, you know？
...That's no good! Take better care of yourself! Don't make your girlfriend worry...
If you don't sleep properly, you won't shake off the fatigue. Not that I'm one to talk.
You should probably get a decent amount of exercise, too. I'll... well, I'll try my best too.
Make sure you eat proper meals. If you want, I'll even cook for you.
Eating nothing but snacks isn't good for you. I'll watch the potato chips and stuff, too.
You're gonna catch a cold. Make sure you stay warm when you sleep.
That's no good. Leaving the AC on all night isn't good for you.
That place we went to today was fun, wasn't it？
Hey, that place we went to the other day was fun, wasn't it？
We got to play all kinds of mini-games. Let's do it again.
Having the photos printed out like that is nice. It's great to have a keepsake.
Medal games really get you pumped up! I think I want to play again.
That jackpot was amazing! I definitely want to see that again.
Plus we got a scratch card. Let's go again.
Huh!? Out of nowhere...... What, are you trying to get me to say 'me too'？
You're not fooling me with sweet talk, you know.
Yeah... I... um, love you, too.
Huh... Do I have to say it too？ No, I really can't. But I feel the same way.
Don't just casually drop that here. ...It makes me happy, though.
Anyone can just say the words, you know...
Yeah, um... I guess I love you. Well, even without the 'I guess,' yeah.
...I do like you, but... try to think about me a little more.
...You're really asking me that right now？
I don't really mind, but... think about how I feel a little more.
...Yeah. Well, if it's just for a bit.
What am I gonna do with you... Fine, fine.
Right now...？ I really wish you'd learn to read the room.
Honestly, you always jump right to saying stuff like that.
Don't you get embarrassed saying that stuff yourself？
It makes it look like this is all we ever think about.
Talking like this is really a couple thing, huh.
This kind of thing is nice, isn't it.
Ugh, it's no use. I can't stop myself from smiling.
Huh, my face is red？ Well, I can't help it.
It's embarrassing, but... it makes me happy.
Hey, can I ask you something too？
It's not fair if it's only ever you.
My turn now. That's okay, right？
Now it's my turn to ask.
Hey, let me ask you something now.
▲新主人公▲. ...What do you think of me calling you that？
I see... Hehe, maybe I'll try calling you that from now on？
▲新主人公▲. Hmm, actually, never mind. It's kind of embarrassing.
Oh, figures. It was kind of fun, though.
Hey... it's a secret, so... lend me your ear a sec.
Bring your ear closer, okay？ ...I don't want anyone else to hear.
Can you hear me？ If you can, say "I can hear you" nice and loud, okay？
I want to stay with you forever...
You're the only one for me...
Almost the end of the year, huh... A chance to stay up late legally.
New Year's was fun, huh. I feel a little more grown-up now.
Valentine's Day is almost here... Now, what should I do.
How was Valentine's Day？ I was pretty happy with how it went.
White Day's almost here... White Day's almost here.
April Fools' is almost here... My brain cells are gonna come up with the ultimate lie.
April Fools' was actually pretty fun.
The field trip's coming up... Time for the classic question! Do bananas count as— ...Actually, never mind.
The field trip was fun, huh. Tiring, sure... but still really fun.
The choir competition is coming up... I wonder why there's no solo competition.
The choir competition was fun. Hehe, I actually got a little moved.
Tanabata's almost here... O Hikoboshi, wherefore art thou Hikoboshi!？
Tanabata was actually pretty fun. Guess it pays to do traditional events properly.
The Towano Festival is coming up... You might get to see my festival-loving side.
The Towano Festival was a blast! That's how a festival should be.
Sports Day is almost here... Sports Day is almost here, huh...
Sports Day was fun! Competing is a pain, but as long as you enjoy the event itself, it's all good.
Halloween's almost here... How about 'Trick AND Treat!'？ No good？
Halloween was surprisingly lively. Not bad at all.
The school festival is coming up... We can expect great things this year! I think!
The school festival really turned into a great memory. Hehe.
Thanks for Christmas. It made for the best memory.
Hey, your birthday's coming up, right？ Is there anything you want？
Think that's something I could get for you？
I'll see what I can do. Sorry if I can't pull it off.
My birthday's coming up soon. Do you know what I want？
The right answer is... first off, hearing you say happy birthday, of course. Hehe.
The right answer is... a kiss that's a little more special than usual... Maybe.
The right answer is... special time spent with you, of course.
Hey, how should we spend our anniversary？
Just getting to be together all day makes me happy, though.
You know, I think... I'd really like something to commemorate the two of us.
I see... Okay, I'll think about it.
Hey, what's your New Year's resolution？
Huh, sounds good to me. I'll be rooting for you, too.

Had a date with him today. We met up, talked a bunch... and that was it. So why was it this much fun？ Having a boyfriend really is nice.

We've been doing nothing but going on dates lately. Not that I'd mind going out with him every single day, if that's what he wants.
Thanks to our after-school date today, all my tiredness from class just vanished. With a reward like this, maybe I can actually try hard at school every day.

Today's date had a different vibe than usual... It kinda made my heart race. Looks like he planned a bunch of things out ahead of time, too. I really couldn't ask for more as a girlfriend. ...Lucky me!

Oh man... he was amazing today! It felt like he knew exactly how I felt without me saying a word, and he kept saying all the right things to make my heart flutter. I think I'm falling for him even harder.
Feels like I'll sleep great tonight. He was so sweet to me, and the date was crazy fun. I bet he feels the same way, too. We were definitely on the exact same wavelength today.
Just a normal date today. It was normal fun, and he was his normal sweet self. Well, they say normal is best anyway. Definitely a passing grade.
Even when nothing special happens, dates really are fun. That's gotta be because he likes me so much, right？ Well, I feel the same way about him, though.
I don't know... Today was kinda meh, maybe. Like we were out of sync, or... like he wasn't even looking at me... Oh well, guess I'll just have to bring my A-game next time!
I feel so restless... This is totally because of today's date. If it was gonna be like that, I'd rather we hadn't gone at all... He'd better make it up to me next time.
He complimented my hair today. I'd better make a mental note of this. So that's the style he likes, huh... Good to know.
I love it when I pick out an outfit with his tastes in mind and totally nail it. I wanna figure out more of what he likes and make him call me cute.

On the way back from our date, I invited him over to my place. I was worried he might not want to because of my family and all... but he came over surprisingly easily. Hanging out in my own room might actually be pretty nice.
He invited me over to his place after our date. Guess he still wanted to be with me. What a sweetheart. His place is actually pretty relaxing, though.
The place we went to eat today was a total jackpot. If I could cook food that good, I bet he'd fall head over heels for me all over again...
While we were eating today, we kinda ended up feeding each other... It was embarrassing so I hesitated a little, but we're a couple, so... there's nothing wrong with that, right？
We ended up feeding each other again today. And the worst part is, I think I'm actually getting used to it. Man, what is happening to me...
I think I was the one getting all lovey-dovey with him today. I mean, I couldn't help it—I wanted to. Wonder what he thought... Think it made him happy？
He was way too handsy today, and I didn't really know what to do with him. I mean, I'm happy he likes me and all, but... getting touched that much is kinda exhausting.
I wanted to set the mood today, so I tried being the assertive one for a change. It kind of just happened naturally. I mean, I really do like him.
Just when I thought the mood was right for a kiss, he got way too pushy. What a letdown. I wish he'd be a little more gentle with me.
Today I ended up kissing him first without even thinking... Just remembering it makes me want to bury my face in my hands. Is it weird for a girlfriend to be the one to initiate a kiss？
I don't get why he has to kiss me so roughly like that. You're supposed to treat a girl with more care. Next time he tries pulling that, maybe I'll just kick him.
We kissed so much today... We're going out, so I guess there's nothing weird about it, but... maybe we got a little too lost in our own world...

Just thinking about it is making my face burn all over again... I don't even know what came over me, not being able to stop kissing like that. I was so swept up in the moment, I didn't even stop to worry if someone might see us.
Was I acting a little strange today...？ Even I don't really know what came over me. What does it mean when I get that bold...？ Maybe that was just me being honest with my feelings...
He took a ton of pictures of me today. No idea what was going through his head, but... well, it was fun, so whatever. I'll have him take some more sometime.
Why do I get so nervous having my picture taken？ I bet my face looks super weird in them... If he's going to save them, I really wish he'd only keep the ones where I actually look good...
Letting him take my picture was fine and all, but it felt kind of embarrassing. Am I just overthinking it？ Why can't we just take normal pictures in a normal way？

The weather was gloomy today, but inside I felt like it was nothing but blue skies. We got to share an umbrella, after all. Just the two of us under one umbrella... Yeah, maybe rain isn't so bad once in a while.
Going out to eat together is always a good chance to figure out his tastes. Though honestly, the best thing is when he likes the same food I do.
Lately, I've been wanting to get better at cooking. Maybe I'll practice with that cookbook he gave me. If I can make a really good meal, I'm sure he'll be happy too.
I invited him over and made him dinner, and he loved it. Which left me feeling pretty proud of myself, too. Guess all that practice paid off. Maybe I'll cook for him again sometime.
Today I made dinner and we ate together. His reaction was pretty decent, I think？ It turned out okay, but next time I'm definitely going to make him say it's delicious.
I cooked for him today, and it didn't really go over too well... Ugh, how frustrating. Where did I mess up？ I have to practice more so I can really blow him away next time!
I went over to his place this morning to make him breakfast. Fixing breakfast and leaving the house together felt like we were a married couple. ...Not that I'd ever say that out loud.

Making lunch is actually really fun. Strangely enough, when it's for him, I don't mind the effort at all. Doing it for anyone else would be a total pain, though... I just like seeing his face light up.
Out of nowhere, he gave me a present today. For a second I panicked, thinking I'd forgotten an anniversary or something. A surprise gift, huh... Gotta hand it to him, that was pretty smooth.
We studied together today. He actually worked way harder than I expected, which caught me off guard. Alright, I can't let him outdo me—I've gotta try hard too.
We went to the trouble of studying together, and all he did was slack off. It completely killed my motivation, too... If I bomb my next test, I'm holding him responsible.
I feel like he's been asking me to meet up a lot lately. He doesn't have to be so needy—it's not like I'm going anywhere. Well, I guess it doesn't feel bad knowing he wants to see me.
He asked to meet up, so I went, and it felt like he was way more interested in getting handsy than actually talking. Is that all he cares about？ I mean, I guess it still means he likes me, but...
Why hasn't he texted me？ It's lonely, you idiot... Hanging out and talking on the phone are great and all, but texting is an important part of staying in touch, too.
Maybe I've been texting him a little too much lately. I should probably save some things to talk about in person. Besides, I don't want to overwhelm him and become a nuisance.
I'd been feeling a little on edge lately, but what he said today completely cleared the air for me. I'm glad we managed to avoid a fight.
When we got into a fight, I didn't know what to do... but once we actually talked things through, we were able to make up. I guess our wires just got crossed a little. I need to work on myself, too.
Caught a cold and I feel awful... But he came over to check on me, and I think it actually perked me up a little. He really is sweet.
I heard he caught a cold, so I went to check on him. He looked better than I expected, which was a relief, but... I still can't help worrying a little. I hope he gets well soon...
He gave me a diary. I might not be able to keep up with it every single day, but I'll write in it as often as I can. I have a feeling most of it's going to be about him, though...

Today is a special, unforgettable anniversary. I never could have known feelings like this all on my own. I'm really grateful to him for giving me the happiness of building another year together like this.

Today is his birthday. Picking out a present was a bit of a struggle, but he seemed to like it, so I'm glad. And just like that, he's another year older, and I'll never be able to catch up to him... Well, obviously.
Today is my birthday. He got me a really thoughtful present, too, but the gift isn't what makes me happiest. It's that he's always there by my side... That's what really makes me happy.

Today is Christmas—what they call a special night for lovers. I've read about it in books plenty of times and seen it all over town. All those things that used to feel like they belonged to someone else's world are slowly becoming part of mine.

Today is Valentine's Day. I get it if you're confessing to someone, but I always wondered what the point was for couples who are already together... Still, maybe it's there so we can remind each other how we feel.

It's White Day, and he made sure to get me something back. Who even came up with that rule about paying back three times as much on White Day？ Just getting something from him already makes it feel five times as special to me.
I rang in the New Year with him this time. Being together at the exact moment one year turns into the next... is kind of amazing. Here's to another good year with you.
Today was the school festival. I wasn't expecting much at first, but spending it with him... turned out to be surprisingly fun. Looks like I've got one more precious memory to hold on to.
Today was the dreaded sports festival. Even though I was dreading it, having him there actually made it fun. I guess it wasn't half bad.

Some guy I don't know talked to me today. Transferring in out of nowhere and joining the committee is just ridiculous. He's only going to get in my way. He seems like a total pain, so I'm going to avoid him as much as I can.
I got hassled today by some jerk I trashed at the arcade. Seriously the worst. Good thing that guy showed up when he did, or who knows what would've happened... Honestly, I was a little scared.
I blurted out that he was my boyfriend in the heat of the moment, which doesn't even make sense... Like someone like him would ever be my boyfriend. As if... I barely even know the guy...

Those people came over to the house today, so I went out. I don't hate them, and of course they aren't bad people, I just can't do it. I'm only in the way there anyway, so I figured I'd get some fresh air and clear my head.

Normally that'd be the end of it, except... someone actually kept me company today. Thanks to him, I think my mood lifted a little. Maybe it's just me, but having someone by my side might actually be kind of nice.

I really hate going out on hot days, but I didn't have much choice. Those people were coming over, so I had to make myself scarce and stay out of the way. Besides... a certain nosy somebody came up and talked to me.
I figured even someone like him might take my mind off things... I didn't have high hopes or anything, but he might've proved me a little wrong.

For some reason, I ended up going to the zoo today. Not that I was dying to go or anything, it was just awkward being at home. And we only went to the zoo because he suggested it, not because I picked it.

He's such a weirdo. He should just leave me alone, but he keeps bothering me. I did feel a little lighter when I got home, though. Is that what they call animal therapy？ Or maybe it was because of him... Yeah, right.

I like the ocean in winter. The leaden gray sea and sky bleed together until you can't tell where one ends and the other begins. It kind of feels like the way I do inside whenever those people come over. Obviously he wouldn't know any of that, but he's the one who took me there.
Maybe he just invited me on a whim. He really should just leave me alone. Still, thanks to him, I feel like my own sky cleared up a little... or something like that. Maybe it's just my imagination.

I hate amusement parks. All I ever notice are the families, and it makes me start overthinking everything about my life right now. My new family, my dad, me... It's not like those people did anything wrong, and my dad... isn't to blame either. I'm the only one who isn't handling it well. And because of that, I lash out at people who have nothing to do with it... and push everyone away...

Even so, the one weirdo who actually bothers with me took me out today. At first, I wasn't having much fun. I thought it might take my mind off things, but seeing all the families still got on my nerves. It's supposed to be a fun place, yet it felt like I was surrounded by enemies. And in the middle of all that, he was the one person who told me he'd be on my side.

It made me really happy. Just knowing I wasn't alone took such a huge weight off my chest. I never knew how reassuring it could be just to have someone there with me. A special day spent with the person who taught me something so important. Today was my first date.
Is this what it's like having an older brother？ That's what I thought at first. He's reliable, and he pays attention to me whenever I look lonely. But somehow, I don't think that's quite it.
He's not... like a brother, is he. If he were family, my heart wouldn't race just from being near him... And I wouldn't want to be with him all the time, or hold his hand, or have him look at me.
Before I know it, he's all I ever think about... What am I supposed to do with these feelings？ I guess that's one thing my 'big brother' can't teach me.
I'm not his little sister. Sure, I'm a year younger, and maybe I'm a little short. And okay, maybe I'm always causing him trouble, asking him for advice and having him help me out with everything.
But treating me like a little sister just because of that is completely wrong. If that's all I am to him, things between us will never change.

My heart races whenever I'm next to him. Just brushing against him makes my head feel like it's gonna explode. A little sister is NOT what I want to be. I wonder if that stupid 'big brother' even gets that!

I wonder what it would've been like if I'd had an older brother. Would I have let myself be totally spoiled by him？ Always sticking close, wanting his attention, giving him a hard time... I wonder how it would've been.
Still, it's not an older brother I want. What I want is him—the guy who always helps me out, who's kind to me even when I give him a hard time, and... who promised he'd stay by my side.
What I want to be is your one and only special person. Couldn't you tell me how to make you understand that？ I'm really at a loss here.

The library was noisy again today. If you want to chat, go do it somewhere else, seriously. And then they have the nerve to snap back at me when I tell them to be quiet... It's exhausting. They act like a bunch of grade-schoolers. Unbelievable.

And then he showed up again... That new guy on the committee who's been bugging me lately stuck his nose into it again. I'm the one in the right here, and if that makes me a few enemies... then so what？ I wish he'd just leave me alone...

I went back to the arcade today, but... I played terribly again. Couldn't win at all. Every time I sit down at a versus cabinet, I keep thinking that gorilla of a guy might barge in again... Thanks to that, I can't concentrate at all.

Except the person who came up to me today was him. Seriously, what is he, a hall monitor or a truant officer or something？ He's only a year older than me. Still, the last time he came with me to the arcade, I played really well... What even is he to me, anyway...？

How should I even write about today？ I want to put something down, but I can't find the right words. It'd be easy enough if I just wrote down what happened, and if a diary is only meant to be a record of events, maybe that'd be fine. But that's not it.

What I want to write about right now isn't what happened—it's how I feel. Only I don't know how to express it. Because I've never felt anything like this before. Stringing together words I've read in books wouldn't do it justice. How do the people who write those books put feelings like this into words, anyway？ Um, anyway, I'm getting sidetracked.

A tiny feeling born from the smallest moment grew bigger, and bigger, and bigger. Until I couldn't hold it inside anymore, and I didn't know what else to do. It felt like it was going to crush me, so I decided to let it all out.

I didn't know what would happen. For all I knew, I'd end up regretting it, wishing I'd just let those feelings crush me instead. Even so, I made up my mind. I wanted him to hear how I felt. I wanted the person I needed to tell most of all to hear me out. My true feelings. I love you.
Written down, it's just three little words. Who knew they'd carry so much weight when you really mean them. And what that guy... what my boyfriend gave me in return... was a kiss.
